title: UFO Moviez Q1FY27 Revenue Up 3% to ₹1,118 Mn
description: UFO Moviez India Ltd announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1FY27). Consolidated revenues grew by 3% year-on-year to ₹1,118 million from ₹1,090 million in Q1FY26. Advertisement revenue saw a significant uptick of 33%, reaching ₹373 million compared to ₹280 million in the prior year's quarter. Despite this growth, EBITDA slightly decreased to ₹189 million from ₹193 million, and Profit Before Tax (PBT) fell to ₹80 million from ₹89 million. Profit After Tax (PAT) was ₹56 million, down from ₹65 million in Q1FY26. The company cited fewer film releases but highlighted the strong performance of "Dhurandhar: The Revenge" and continued operational execution as drivers for advertisement revenue growth. The company operates India's largest in-cinema advertising platform with a network of 3,891 screens.
